name: C-K12B rapid fire cannon
description: The C-K12B rapid fire cannon was a model of laser cannon that could be equipped to starships and could fire bursts at multiple targets. Equipping an EML-850 light freighter with a C-K12B rapid fire cannon cost two thousand credits and required a X-FP-C28 ship computer, twenty units of quadanium steel, and eight heuristic processors.
